==Notes==
* This boss can hit for large amounts of damage. It is recommended to spread your team to avoid its [[area of effect]] attacks.
* This boss relies almost entirely on physical damage, so [[block]]ing and causing its attacks to [[miss]] are effective ways to prevent damage.
